title: Skill installation fails clearly when no usable destination is supplied

setupFiles.blocked-destination: Keep this existing file exactly as written.

expectation: Missing --dir produces corrective guidance without installing globally; a destination occupied by a file fails with the exact destination named and preserves that file.

checks.command: monochange skill install > .missing.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .missing.out; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'pass --dir' .missing.out && test ! -e SKILL.md
checks.why: The CLI must not guess a global runtime or silently install into the current directory.

checks.command: monochange skill install --dir blocked-destination > .blocked.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat .blocked.out; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -Fq 'error[io.failed]' .blocked.out && grep -q 'blocked-destination' .blocked.out && test "$(cat blocked-destination)" = 'Keep this existing file exactly as written.'
checks.why: A file in place of a directory must produce an actionable IO error and remain unchanged.
